messages:
Aisha Kaur: Quick sync request — stitching runtime + infra + security for the Q3 vector-ops rollout. Key customer ask: deterministic low-latency streaming (target p95 ~50ms for 256–512 token responses). I want an aligned launch checklist and owners. Proposed scope cut: core streaming path + canary with 2 customers + graceful fallback to hosted.
Carlos Mendes: +1. Need clarity on what 'core streaming path' includes. Is it just prefix/KV caching + batching, or also kernel selection for int8 models?
Jin Park: For our runtime, core path = KV/prefix cache + continuous batching + kernel select. Int8 kernel work is heavier — could be a follow-up unless needed for p95.
Marta Lopez: Autoscaling and infra warm pools are big dependency. If we can lock burst pools and pre-warm kernels, infra side can hit p95 more often. But warming depends on model binary readiness from eng-runtime.
Ethan Rhodes: Security blockers: KMS integration for private deployments and audit logging for canary customers. KMS can't be stubbed for enterprise canaries. ETA for KMS hookup affects launch.
Samir Patel: From solutions: the two pilot customers require SOC2-level logs + customer-side key support. They said no go unless KMS + audit present.
Priya Nair: UX/console items: canary toggle + per-customer logs in Console. Low effort to expose toggle, but needs product+eng-infra handshake.
Aisha Kaur: OK — decision candidates:
- Ship hosted canary without KMS for public beta, but enterprise canary blocked until KMS done.
- Or delay canary until KMS done and do internal canary only.
Which path safer?
Carlos Mendes: Risk-wise, host-only public canary is lower infra cost but won't satisfy enterprise pilots. We should parallelize: infra works KMS; runtime ships core path for hosted canary.
Jin Park: Agree. We'll gate kernel/int8 work to post-canary. Runtime owner: @Jin Park. Deliverable: streaming core + KV caching + continuous batching stable on dedicated infra. Target branch: feature/vector-stream.
Marta Lopez: Infra owner: @Marta Lopez. Deliverable: pre-warmed node pool + canary routing + per-tenant audit hooks. Need model binary packaging from runtime by 2026-06-15 to set up warm pools.
Ethan Rhodes: Security owner: @Ethan Rhodes. Deliverable: KMS integration + audit log schema. I'll need API contract from infra and a test plan. Target: 2026-06-22 for KMS PoC.
Samir Patel: I'll coordinate pilot customer expectations and accept the hosted-only canary if we provide a clear timeline for KMS. Will draft a customer comms note.
Priya Nair: Console owner: @Priya Nair. I'll ship canary toggle + logs UI for internal usage first. Target: 2026-06-18 for internal demo.
Aisha Kaur: Great. Blockers called out: (1) KMS integration (security) — blocks enterprise canary; (2) model binary packaging + kernel readiness — affects infra warm pools.
Action items & owners:
- Jin: complete runtime core streaming (feature/vector-stream) — target 2026-06-12
- Marta: infra warm pools + canary routing — target 2026-06-16 (depends on Jin)
- Ethan: KMS PoC + audit schema — target 2026-06-22
- Priya: console canary toggle + logs UI demo — target 2026-06-18
- Samir: customer comms + pilot alignment — draft by 2026-06-14
Aisha Kaur: Launch criteria (must-haves):
- p95 streaming <= 50ms for 256 tokens on canary infra (hosted): measurement harness results
- Can toggle canary per-customer
- Fallback path to hosted model variant if dedicated path overloaded
- Audit logs available for pilot customers (enterprise pilot only after KMS)
Carlos Mendes: Let's capture SLOs in a concise snippet to include in the PR and runbook:
```
SLO: streaming_p95 <= 50ms @ 256 tokens
Measurement: 95th percentile over 5m window, sustained for 30m
Fallback: route -> hosted_variant_v1 within 200ms if queue > threshold
```
Jin Park: I'll add a perf test job to the runtime repo that emits the measurement above and ships metrics to console.
Marta Lopez: Infra will add a canary routing rule that honors per-tenant toggle and does traffic mirroring for metrics.
Ethan Rhodes: Security: KMS PoC depends on customer key format. Samir — please collect sample key configs from pilot customers by 2026-06-10.
Samir Patel: Will do. Also flag: one pilot requires FIPS-compliant KMS; might push timeline. I'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.
Aisha Kaur: Long pole looks like KMS FIPS ask. If FIPS required, propose enterprise pilot delayed 3 weeks. Everyone ok with hosted public canary in meantime?
Carlos Mendes: OK with hosted public canary as long as we label it clearly and block enterprise release behind KMS.
Priya Nair: Agreed.
redwood-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/vector-stream -> staging on 2026-06-11.
Aisha Kaur: Next sync Thursday 2026-06-13 10:00 PT. Please update the checklist PR with the action items and owners. I'll track blockers in the roadmap doc and notify execs if KMS hits FIPS delay.
Jin Park: Noted.
Marta Lopez: Noted.
Ethan Rhodes: Noted.
Samir Patel: Noted — I'll start customer outreach.
Priya Nair: I'll post a quick mock of the toggle UI today.
Aisha Kaur: Thanks team :rocket:
